caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, off-white background. The object consists of three main elements: at the top, there is a standing figure of a woman in classical attire with a helmet and a shield, rendered in shades of brown and beige with some black outlining. The figure stands atop a vertical, fluted column, which is gray with detailed black lines to indicate grooves and contours. The column connects to a large circular base that is gold or amber in color, with a painted scene inside the circle. The interior of the circle includes a decorative border in darker red-brown, and an inner central area showing a coat of arms or similar emblem with green, white, and red-orange coloring, as well as intricate patterns and designs. The rest of the page is unembellished, and the composition is symmetrical and vertically oriented.
title: Souvenir Spoon
